manifest_note: Preregistration facts for MASI-E001 only. Not a MASI system schema, not a MASI Bus message, not an execution authorization. PROTOCOL.md governs; on any conflict, PROTOCOL.md wins and this file is a defect.
h2a: not_confirmatory; optional estimation-only module S-H2A requires operator activation before implementation
primary_quality_metric: Q = macro-F1 over retained dimensions of evidenced concern; all assigned locked-main-test units in denominator; ERROR/WITHHELD/missing = non-E
coverage_floor_metric: R = macro recall of evidenced concern
primary_property_metric: EVCP = verified E-claims / E-claims; verified iff gold E, >=1 valid cited support span, token precision of cited-support union vs gold support spans >= 0.5

decision_rule.method: intersection-union test; each component one-sided 0.025 via two-sided 95% paired cluster-bootstrap CI; no multiplicity adjustment within H2B
decision_rule.Q_NI: for each k in {B0, C_A, C_B}: lower CI(Q_T - Q_k) > -delta_Q
decision_rule.R_NI: for each k in {B0, C_A, C_B}: lower CI(R_T - R_k) > -delta_Q
decision_rule.P_SUP: for each g in {C_A, C_B}: lower CI(EVCP_T - EVCP_g) > 0 and point >= delta_P
decision_rule.fail_regions: Q_NI/R_NI FAIL iff upper CI < -delta_Q; P_SUP FAIL iff upper CI < delta_P; otherwise UNDECIDED

margins.delta_Q: clamp((1 - F1_h)/2, 0.02, 0.05); F1_h = annotator-pair macro-F1 on E over retained dimensions, double-annotated dev, computed before any arm runs [BIND value]

multiplicity: single confirmatory hypothesis H2B; all other analyses descriptive with unadjusted 95% CIs

gates.G1_reliability: Krippendorff alpha (nominal, binary E) >= 0.667 per dimension to retain; >2 dimensions failing -> halted
gates.G2_span_stability: EVCP_h >= 0.80 on double-annotated dev; else halted
gates.G4_minimum_sample: locked main test >= 500 units, >= 100 clusters, >= 60 gold-E per retained dimension, >= 5 retained dimensions

split_method.unit_of_assignment: cluster (scenario card + variants; near-duplicates merged at char-5-gram Jaccard >= 0.6)
split_method.salt: 32 random bytes hex by custodian; SHA-256(salt) committed before assignment visible; revealed at U2; no re-salting

C_A.decoding: greedy, single pass, reasoning modes off, no retries

T.escalation: dev only, after B0/C_A/C_B frozen: Q_dev(r) < max(Q_dev(B0), Q_dev(C_A), Q_dev(C_B)) - delta_Q AND >=50% dev FNs have NO_CANDIDATE_MENTION

optional_arms.F1: descriptive only; operator activation; written provider-terms check permits publication; not generator family; <= USD 150
optional_arms.S_H2A: estimation only; LoRA of selected C_A base; operator activation before implementation

allowed_development_data: train + dev + dev-visible portions of BND/ADV/SR (texts, gold, spans); unlimited CV inside train; per arm <=60 dev-mini (deterministic: dev clusters in ascending SHA-256('devmini:'+cluster_id) until >=100 units) and <=12 full-dev evaluations
unlock_sequence: U1 locked inputs only after artifact hashes committed
U2 gold + salt only after raw predictions committed

resource_ceilings.hardware: Mac mini M4, 16 GB unified memory, local (except optional F1)
resource_ceilings.energy: not measured; no energy claims permitted

stop_conditions: S10 cannot separate H2B from prompting/adaptation
publication_restrictions: no private/sensitive data; ADCP text not imported (no ADCP license); F1 results unpublished unless terms permit; frontier generation prohibited unless terms permit training use of outputs; corpus release license [BIND before release]
blocking_items_before_implementation: B4 F1 and S-H2A activation decisions
independent audit acceptance of this protocol
